summary: The trace demonstrates a successful economic time series analysis with a specific pattern: using a 'selector' workbook to choose between multiple data sources (A/B) and versions for each time period. This is a new pattern not covered by the existing skill - the agent had to join a selector table with multiple update files to construct the final series. The existing skill covers status flags, priority columns, and catalog files, but not this 'selector-driven source/version resolution' pattern. Adding this pattern to the skill will help future agents recognize and handle similar multi-source selection tasks.
